entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: A massively powerful artifact on Ulgrotha, owned by the Tolgath and rung by Ravi to end the Great War.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: A party in the Great War on Ulgrotha, destroyed by the Chime.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: The other party in the Great War on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: A girl given the Apocalypse Chime by her master; she rang it, was trapped for centuries, was freed by Baron Sengir and became mad Grandmother Sengir.

entities.name: Great War
entities.description: The war between the Tolgath and the Ancients on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Great Destruction
entities.description: The catastrophe caused by the Chime that formed the Dead Zone.

entities.name: Dead Zone
entities.description: A region of Ulgrotha formed when the Chime disrupted the world's mana channels.

entities.name: Basalt Spire
entities.description: Place on Ulgrotha where Ravi hid in a magical coffin.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler of Castle Sengir who found and freed Ravi.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who visited Castle Sengir with Feroz.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who visited Castle Sengir with Serra.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: Stronghold of Baron Sengir on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where the Chime was used.

events.summary: Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime during the Great War, destroying both sides and causing the Great Destruction.
events.quote: Ravi, hoping to stop the killing, rang the chime and destroyed both parties

events.summary: Ravi hid in a magical coffin in the Basalt Spire and was trapped for centuries, going mad.
events.quote: Trapped, Ravi lay in stasis, awake, unable to dream, aware of every second for centuries.

events.summary: Baron Sengir found and freed Ravi after centuries.
events.quote: After centuries, Baron Sengir found and freed her.

events.summary: Serra and Feroz visited Castle Sengir, where Grandmother Sengir still held the Chime.
events.quote: Now called Grandmother Sengir, she still had the Apocalypse Chime when Serra and Feroz visited Castle Sengir

relations.quote: The Apocalypse Chime was a massively powerful artifact owned by the Tolgath
After centuries, Baron Sengir found and freed her.
